title: Verify P112 paired endpoints and paid isolated helper return
body:
## Summary

Complete the fixed P112 paired-endpoint calculation and make the isolated dirty-helper return literal. The historical contact restores the helper's logical value but leaves its physical frame changed; the added inverse transition restores every arbitrary helper input and raises the complete native rank mass to 16 or 18 for contact ranks 2 or 3 (four signed ADDs, coefficients ±1). Rank-one contacts need no helper.

The package checks 112 paired contracts, 456 exact canonical/native gauges and 224 rank-seven residuals; proves the signed B4 identity over the Laurent ring; reconstructs all 5,824 fixed order-three contacts; and certifies maximum eight in the stipulated triangular-zero source-batched model. It retains actual phase defects, complete deterministic receipts and a shared full-contract consistency gate.

## Scope and limits

One local interface contribution under `research/p112-paired-endpoints`. Native B4 executions cover address dimensions 11 and 12 with one residual axis per stage; the conditional written operator argument has broader dimension coverage. Contact phase/rank verification covers every edge, while compiler lowering is independently replayed for twelve representative transition instances. The contact invoice is for ±1 coefficients.

These isolated contacts do not assemble a compatible shared many-edge word. Canonical adapters, helper ownership, rounding, full recursive stock and physical access remain paid/open. No selected result, frontier, shared runner or predecessor package is changed; no new kappa or formal-kernel proof is claimed.

## Test plan

Passed on CPython 3.12.14 at commit `d81ccede589450c7c6e428e3fac172d9e603a805`:

- Committed package/source-history preflight.
- All three registered commands: endpoint, geometry and compact controls.
- The same three commands from a read-only Git-free export with spaces in its path.
- Full normal/optimized receipt equality; 125 endpoint rejections plus one phase-guard deletion, 14 geometry rejections/deletions, and 64 compact rejections with 14 guard deletions per mode.

Separate AI contexts reviewed endpoint mathematics, contact mathematics and source/control integrity. All 23 frozen input blobs match the committed objects; the review snapshot covers every package file except itself. Automatic hosted [CI run39441953876](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39441953876) passed at the same commit `d81ccede589450c7c6e428e3fac172d9e603a805` (plan and package replay).

## Sources and credit

Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Original October 18 paired-endpoint and geometry drafts are retained unchanged; PR425/433/523/531 supplier ancestry and the kernel92 compiler lineage retain their notices and Apache-2.0 license. Scientific inputs are pinned to `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; task/provenance metadata uses canonical base `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`. `DATA-PHASES` is historical provenance only, not a semantic supplier replay. Separate AI review is not independent human acceptance.
